tools.name: search_uk_companies
tools.description: Use when you need the Companies House number of a live UK company from its name. Free. Dissolved and post-snapshot companies are excluded. Returns up to 10 live UK companies whose name starts with the query.

tools.name: uk_company_check
tools.description: Use when you must vet a live UK company (supplier, customer, counterparty, lead): registry status, age, overdue accounts or confirmation statement, dormant flag, outstanding charges, previous names, and an FCDO UK Sanctions List name screen, with sources. Costs 1 credit on found companies (404 not_f

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "uk_company_check" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Use when you must vet a live UK company (supplier, customer, counterparty, lead): registry status, age, overdue accounts or confirmation statement, dormant flag…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_uk_companies · Public sink: search_uk_companies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_uk_companies · Public sink: search_uk_companies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
